brand_identity.tagline: Private by default. Scriptable by design.
brand_identity.theme_preference: dark-first with high-contrast terminal neon accents (cyan + magenta), supporting light theme toggle

gradients.card_highlight: radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(34,230,255,0.12), transparent 70%)

section_order.description: Rebrand pill notification + quick status ('Nameword is now hosta.sh | Offshore Privacy Engine Live')
Inspired by Hostnet.nl Hero. Live domain search input bar + 3 big featured promo cards (Cloud VPS, Anti-Red Hosting, Anonymous Domains).
Row of 4 uniform product price cards matching Hostnet.nl card anatomy: Optional 'Deal' badge, product title, one-liner, 'from $X/mo', key feature pills, CTA 'Go to <Product>'.
'Register a domain: pick your favourite extension' row of TLD cards (.com, .sh, .is, .ky, .cc, .privacy) with instant 'Check' button and 'View all TLDs'.
Hostnet-style mission/video block translated to hosta.sh: 'Your Road to Resilient Infrastructure' showcasing zero-KYC, DMCA resilience, and API automation.
'From Idea to Online Infrastructure' 3-column product card showcase with visual preview blocks for Cloud VPS, Windows RDP, and cPanel Web Hosting.
3 core value pillars: 1) Offshore Resilient (DMCA-ignored datacenters), 2) No-KYC Crypto Prepaid (BTC/ETH/USDT), 3) Scriptable by Design (REST API & CLI).
Detailed live pricing cards for Cloud VPS, Windows RDP, and cPanel Hosting fetched from API.
'Offshore Support & 24/7 Telegram Operations' + quick email contact & documentation links.
No fake names/ratings: honest technical uptime metric (99.98%), crypto wallet instant refill guarantee, zero log policy.
Accordion with instant answers on payment, KYC, DMCA policy, and API access.
Terminal-style prompt CTA: '$ hosta launch --privacy=max' + CTA button to register or order server.

elements: Background: Dark server datacenter photo with dark overlay (bg-black/50) + cyan/magenta gradient light bleed
Content: Bold headline, 1-line promise, hover arrow button ('Discover now ->')

accessibility_and_testing.apca_contrast: Ensure white/cyan text on dark surfaces meets minimum 4.5:1 ratio

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the exact section blueprint structure defined in structure_blueprint_hostnet_inspired.
Do not invent fake reviews, fake customer numbers, or fabricated Trustpilot ratings.
Ensure all interactive components (domain search, plan buttons, tabs, accordions) have unique data-testid attributes.
Use Geist for body text and Geist Mono for headings, terminal blocks, code snippets, and pricing numbers.
Maintain high visual contrast using cyan (#22E6FF) and magenta (#FF3DCB) as deliberate glowing accents on dark surfaces (#0A0D14 / #111622).
Keep standard JS / JSX files in the React codebase without breaking syntax.
